title: Newsroom and media

Capco and Molecule announce strategic partnership

                                              

Capco and Molecule have announced a strategic partnership to accelerate ETRM modernization, combining Capco’s deep energy trading and risk expertise with Molecule’s modern, API-first ETRM capabilities to deliver more agile, scalable and data-driven trading and risk operations.
